final_focal.scope: Entry API/controller/cards and legacy composition compatibility after final adjustment

behavior: Existing OperationalHome now has one Follow-up region for work, passive sessions/connections, attention and deliveries.
Groups and all related partitions use backend cursors and totals. No legacy overview/activity requests in entries family.
Existing HomeController owns one serialized generation-bound queue, shared stream invalidation, hidden-tab TTL, pause and auth cleanup.
Focused or expanded contexts hold material ordering updates until Apply updates; stable text can refresh.
Four quick filters and optional details preserve initial recent/unseen window, explicit source partiality and unknown totals.
Composer, canonical inspection/actions, occurrence revision checks, artifacts and old controller consumers remain reused.
limitations: Node/SSR is not mounted-browser, screen-reader or real-harness evidence; UI-028 and panel/onboarding gates remain pending.
Current inspector still needs the composed entry/session/related context gate UI-026/UI-030; this milestone alone does not complete opening a row.
Existing Vite large-chunk warning remains; no performance percentile claim.
effects: Presentation and passive reads; productive actions retain their existing canonical surfaces and authority.
rollback: Revert this presentation/controller extension and rebuild assets. Classic Home and legacy API family remain available; persisted work and connection profiles are untouched.
next: Compose exact entry/session panel; mandatory UI/Connector onboarding; mounted-browser qualification.
